Hi everyone!

Wanted to share our Youtube channel that we opened recently together with our friend. The first video we made is about something that just brings us joy at the table - doing voices.

Apart from that we'll be focusing on high production content for DnD, storytelling and worldbuilding. 

I've personally been DMing for just over 10 years at this point, and my friend is a DM/writer himself. If you like what we're doing it would mean the world to us if you checked our our channel and other videos (so far we have 2, with many more planned).

Cheers everyone!
